newsitem.title: UK: Bayer unit launches 375 mln mark 5-yr callable OID.
newsitem.headline: Bayer unit launches 375 mln mark 5-yr callable OID.

text.p: Bayer Corp, a subsidiary of Bayer AG, has launched a 375 million mark Original Issue Discount Convertible, lead manaager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a statement on Thursday.
The bond pays a 1.0 percent coupon annually and is issued at a discount to par (86.14 to 88.19 percent) with a conversion premium of 24 to 26 percent and a maturity of five years.
The bond is callable unconditionally after two years at the accreted value with accrued interest. It is listed on the Frankfurt and Luxembourg Stock Exchanges.
Commissions are 2.5 percent, split 1.0 percent management and underwriting fees and 1.5 percent selling concession.
The final pricing is expected later today.
